authorization: PI request: work all 34 restored groups through standard post-BOI checks and queue any that qualify; also schedule all 70 shallow groups without Rust/MK clock matches, most promising first; include PSF_FLAT discoveries. Internal storage authorized.
schedule: One sequential preparation worker, original-priority order; successful fully prepared cases append atomically to the existing native-fit coordinator. Scientific holds retain REMAINS_PC; software/instrument-method blockers stop the affected intake and require review. Never restart stopped attempts.
